/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/abbas-ka-alam-hai-2.md\")
before = p.read_bytes()
prefix, roman, body = before.split(b'---\\n', 2)
metadata, verses = roman.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
updated = verses.decode()
for old, new in {
    \"hashar ki dhoop main pohchenge\": \"hashr ki dhup mein pahuncheṅ ge\",
    \"dekhenge\": \"dekheṅ ge\",
    \"Farhan or Mazhar kehdenge\": \"Farhan aur Mazhar keh deṅ ge\",
    \"roz e qayamat\": \"roz-e-qayaamat\",
    \"ghum\": \"gham\",
    \"Choda so\": \"Chaudah sau\",
    \"Ooncha rahay ooncha rahay\": \"Uncha rahe uncha rahe\",
    \"alam tera\": \"alam tera\",
    \"Mola\": \"Maula\",
}.items():
    updated = updated.replace(old, new)
result = b'---\\n'.join((prefix, metadata + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated.encode(), body))
p.write_bytes(result)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'---\\n', 2)[2] == body
assert [len(s.splitlines()) for s in updated.strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [12, 7, 7]
PY"
